examples.label: Example 1
examples.display:
payments = [[0, 1, 7, 500], [4, 1, 7, 500], [12, 1, 7, 500], [13, 2, 7, 500], [30, 1, 7, 500]]
window   = 10
output   = [1, 2]

Payment 2 is 8 seconds after payment 1, so it is flagged even though payment 0 was 12 seconds before it. Payment 3 is another user. Payment 4 comes 18 seconds after payment 2.
